 Twenty One Pilots 2026 Tour Dates & Tickets
 October 25, 2026 
 Key Takeaways
 Twenty One Pilots built their 2026 live story around a massive hometown show at Ohio Stadium on October 17, the centerpiece of their festival-heavy year.
 Only one 2026 date remains on sale: Corona Capital on November 21 in Mexico City. Shaky Knees, Oceans Calling, and Ohio Stadium are now past.
 No 2027 Twenty One Pilots tour dates have been announced as of October 2026, and historical patterns suggest announcements typically arrive two to three months before the first show.

 The 2026 Dates In Detail
 Corona Capital 2026, Mexico City
 This is the only remaining buyable Twenty One Pilots date in 2026. Corona Capital runs November 20–22 at Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, and Twenty One Pilots headline on Saturday, November 21.
 The festival carries personal weight for the band. Their sold-out Mexico City stadium show at Estadio GNP on February 20, 2025, recorded as the live album More Than We Ever Imagined (Live In Mexico City) , drew 64,164 fans according to the promoter’s official figure , often rounded to about 65,000. That performance remains the biggest headline show of their career.
 Tickets are sold via Ticketmaster México, with a Banamex presale on May 26, 2026 and general sale on May 27, 2026 .
 Secure Your Mexico City Spot 
 Shaky Knees 2026, Atlanta
 Twenty One Pilots headlined the Peachtree Stage at Shaky Knees on Saturday, September 19, 2026, with a scheduled set of 9:30–11:00 PM. After a weather delay and evacuation, they started at 10:00 PM and played a shortened set that wrapped at 11:00 PM.
 The Atlanta festival served as one of the first North American anchors in the 2026 festival run, with a lineup headlined by Twenty One Pilots, The Strokes, and Gorillaz.
 Oceans Calling 2026, Ocean City
 Twenty One Pilots were scheduled to headline the Sea Bright stage at Oceans Calling on Saturday, September 26, from 9:30–11:00 PM, but the festival was cancelled due to a Nor’easter storm and the performance did not take place .
 The Ocean City, Maryland coastal festival had been positioned as part of a back-to-back weekend stretch, with Atlanta one week and the Maryland shore the next.
 Twenty One Pilots Live 2026, Ohio Stadium
 The centerpiece of the 2026 calendar drew over 102,000 fans to Ohio Stadium, “The Shoe,” for what Kerrang! reported as their longest show ever, featuring a 38-song setlist sourced via setlist.fm . Doors opened at 4:00 PM and stadium lights did not come up until 11:05 PM.
 Death Cab for Cutie and Emi Grace opened the night, setting up a marathon headlining set. The band debuted the Clancy track “At The Risk of Feeling Dumb” and the Breach track “Robot Voices” live, then folded in a cover of The White Stripes’ “Seven Nation Army” with the Ohio State University Marching Band’s drumline.
 The show sold out at primary, and by mid-October resale upper-level seats were running $388–$404 across major marketplaces, with general admission resale above $2,000. The pricing underscored just how intense demand was for the hometown stadium date.
 The Wider 2026 Festival Run
 The four dates above represent the North American and Mexico legs tracked by OnesToWatch Live, but the 2026 season stretched well beyond them.
 Twenty One Pilots opened the year with a European festival circuit. It ran from Pinkpop in Landgraaf (June 19–21) through All Points East in London (August 30), with stops at Rock Werchter, Mad Cool at Iberdrola Music in Madrid on Friday, July 10, their NOS Alive debut as headliners on the Palco NOS on July 9 in Algés, Portugal , Paléo Festival in Nyon (July 21), and Sziget in Budapest on August 12 .
 The Americas leg followed. The band played Osheaga in Montreal (July 31), Sommo Festival in Prince Edward Island (September 11), Rock in Rio in Rio de Janeiro on the festival’s closing night of Sunday, September 13 , Riot Fest in Chicago (September 18–20), and Austin City Limits in Austin, TX (October 4 and October 11). The Ohio Stadium headline and Corona Capital bookend this North American stretch.
 Will Twenty One Pilots Go On Tour In 2027?
 With the 2026 festival run winding down, attention shifts to what comes next, and as of October 2026 no 2027 Twenty One Pilots tour dates have been announced. No specific 2027 date, city, or venue is on record.
 The historical pattern offers a guide. Clancy arrived on May 24, 2024, and the Clancy World Tour began in August 2024, roughly three months later. Breach followed in September 2025, with the Clancy Tour: Breach running September–October 2025 across 23 shows, then giving way to the 2026 festival run.
 The Bandito Tour, supporting Trench , was announced in July 2018 and launched in October 2018, again about three months from announcement to first date. Across these cycles, the band has favored relatively short lead times between news and opening night.
 The 2026 festival season effectively served as the live rollout for Breach . Dork’s coverage of All Points East noted potential hints about future plans but stopped short of confirming anything. LineupScout currently lists no 2027 tour dates or festival appearances for the band.
 The Ohio Stadium sell-out stands as a clear demand signal that often precedes a headline announcement, yet no full 2027 headline run has been confirmed. Fans tracking the next move are watching for a similar two-to-three-month window between announcement and first show.
 To hear about 2027 dates the moment they land, set alerts on the official Twenty One Pilots tour page, the Ticketmaster artist page, and OnesToWatch Live’s artist listings.
 Breach-Era Context Behind The 2026 Festival Focus
 The 2026 festival-heavy approach reflects how strong the Breach era has been for the band. Several milestones help explain why they favored festivals over a traditional headline tour this cycle.
 Breach debuted at #1 on the Billboard 200 in its first week, moving 200,000 equivalent album units, including 169,000 in traditional sales, the biggest rock week since Tool’s Fear Inoculum in 2019.
 The live album More Than We Ever Imagined (Live in Mexico City) was released August 7, 2026 on Fueled by Ramen , capturing the sold-out Estadio GNP show. A global online watch party for the companion concert film took place August 8, 2026, with a live Q&A featuring Tyler Joseph and Josh Dun.
 The concert film received a limited theatrical run beginning February 26, 2026, keeping the Breach era visible on big screens while the band focused on festivals.
 The single “Drag Path” reached #1 on the Alternative Airplay chart in May 2026, giving the duo their 14th chart-topper at the format and tying them for second-most all-time #1s on Alternative Airplay.
 Patterns, Themes, And Tour Takeaways
 Those Breach-era milestones and the 2026 calendar point to a few clear patterns.
 2026 Was A Festival Year. The Clancy World Tour’s original run comprised 73 shows, beginning August 15, 2024 at Denver’s Ball Arena and concluding May 14, 2025 at The O2 arena in London . A later extension, The Clancy Tour: Breach, added 23 more shows in September–October 2025. After that, the band shifted into a major festival circuit, with Ohio Stadium as the lone standalone headline show of 2026.
 The Ohio Stadium Sell-Out Signals Headline-Level Demand. The 102,000-fan hometown show mentioned above sets a clear benchmark for what a 2027 headline tour might target. Previous major tour announcements have followed similarly high-demand moments.
 OnesToWatch Live Fills The Status Gap Other Platforms Leave. Generic ticketing platforms like Ticketmaster often list dates without clear status labels, so past shows can look like upcoming options. OnesToWatch Live labels every date as on sale or past and supplies the direct checkout link for the only remaining buyable date, Corona Capital 2026, while also giving fans a clean path to track future announcements.
 Practical Reader Guidance
 If You Still Want To See Twenty One Pilots In 2026: Corona Capital on November 21 in Mexico City is the only remaining on-sale date. Tickets are available now, and the Ohio Stadium show is past, so resale there no longer matters for planning.
 To Prepare For 2027 Announcements: Set alerts on the official Twenty One Pilots tour page, Ticketmaster, and OnesToWatch Live. Based on past cycles, announcements have arrived as little as three months before a tour’s first date, so a 2027 run could appear with limited lead time.
 Lead-Time Lessons From Past Cycles: The Bandito Tour was announced in July 2018 for an October 2018 start, and the Clancy World Tour began roughly three months after Clancy ‘s May 2024 release. Fans who had alerts set typically bought during presales, while those who relied on social feeds often encountered sold-out primaries.
 Resale Context: The Ohio Stadium show illustrated the resale premium, with upper-level seats in the high hundreds and general admission above $2,000. Buying at primary on-sale remains the most reliable way to avoid that markup.

 Frequently Asked Questions
 Here are the questions listeners are asking most about the 2026 close-out and the 2027 outlook.
 Is There A Twenty One Pilots 2027 Tour?
 No full 2027 Twenty One Pilots tour has been announced as of October 2026, and no 2027 date, venue, or city has been confirmed. The band completed a major festival run in 2026 and has one remaining date, Corona Capital on November 21, before the year closes.
 What Is The Only Remaining On-Sale Twenty One Pilots Date In 2026?
 Corona Capital 2026 on November 21, 2026, at Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez in Mexico City, Mexico. All other 2026 dates, including Shaky Knees on September 19, Oceans Calling on September 26, and Ohio Stadium on October 17, have already taken place or, in the case of Oceans Calling, were cancelled.
 How Big Was The Ohio Stadium Show?
 The Ohio Stadium date was the biggest show of the band’s career, with a 38-song set and a full-stadium crowd. It also marked the longest show they have played to date, as reported by Kerrang, and functioned as the centerpiece of the 2026 calendar.
 How Far In Advance Does Twenty One Pilots Announce Tours?
 Based on documented history, the band tends to announce tours about two to three months before the first date. The Bandito Tour supporting Trench was announced in July 2018 for an October 2018 start, and the Clancy World Tour followed a similar three-month pattern after Clancy ‘s release.
